title: QA Engineer
description:
**NovintiX**  
Fast\-growing engineering and digital transformation consultancy serving Life Sciences, MedTech, and Healthcare clients across US, Ireland, and Europe. Specializing in digital programs, engineering services, and talent solutions that drive innovation, efficiency, and compliance.

**JOB DESCRIPTION** 

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a skilled 2\-4 Years experienced **Application Tester** with strong expertise in **manual and automation testing** to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise applications. The role involves designing test strategies, executing test cases, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver defect\-free solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, execute, and document **manual test cases** for functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Develop and maintain **automation scripts** using frameworks such as **Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright**.
* Perform **API testing** and validate backend processes.
* Conduct **database validations** using **SQL queries**.
* Integrate automated tests into **CI/CD pipelines** for continuous validation.
* Identify, track, and report defects, ensuring timely resolution.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **manual testing methodologies** and defect management.
* Hands\-on experience with **automation frameworks** (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
* Proficiency in **SQL** for backend validation.
* Familiarity with **Azure DevOps, AWS environments, or Jenkins** for CI/CD.
* Solid understanding of **API testing tools**.
* Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

If Interested please apply at rupa.raja@novintix.com

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹477,614\.19 \- ₹1,830,732\.69 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you open to work at onsite 5 days WFO at Coimbatore?
* Do you have 3 Years experience with Manual and Automation Testing?
* Can you start withing 15 Days?

Work Location: In person

title: Jr.Software Tester / QA Tester
description:
**About Innervex**

**Innervex Technologies** is a growing technology solutions company specializing in delivering innovative software products and business applications. We are committed to helping organizations improve efficiency through technology while maintaining the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction. Our team\-driven culture empowers employees to learn, contribute, and grow professionally while working on challenging and rewarding projects.

Job Title: Software Tester / QA Tester  
Experience: 0–2 Years  
Employment Type: Full\-Time  
Location: Madurai and Coimbatore

Contact:9655244899

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and motivated Software Tester to join our Quality Assurance team. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of software testing concepts, test case preparation, defect tracking, and quality assurance processes. Fresh graduates with relevant training, certifications, internships, or project experience in software testing are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand business and functional requirements.
* Create and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts.
* Perform Manual Testing of web, desktop, and mobile applications.
* Identify, document, and track software defects.
* Conduct Functional, Regression, Integration, and System Testing.
* Verify bug fixes and perform re\-testing activities.
* Collaborate with developers and business analysts to resolve issues.
* Prepare test reports and maintain testing documentation.
* Ensure software quality before release to production.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Knowledge of Manual Testing concepts and methodologies.
* Experience in writing and executing test cases.
* Understanding of defect reporting and tracking.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Familiarity with testing tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.
* Knowledge of Functional, Regression, Smoke, and Sanity Testing.
* Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of Automation Testing tools such as Selenium.
* Familiarity with API Testing using Postman.
* Exposure to performance or security testing concepts.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Freshers with software testing certifications, internships, or project experience are welcome to apply.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
* Quick learner with a proactive attitude.

Nice to Have

* Exposure to ERP, CRM, HRMS, or enterprise applications.

Keywords

Software Tester, QA Tester, Manual Tester, Quality Assurance Engineer, Junior Tester, Functional Testing, Regression Testing, STLC, SDLC, Freshers, Entry\-Level QA, Software Testing.

Job Types: Permanent, Full\-time

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Chennai District): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)
* Java: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* Java (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
